data.one_liner: Scan documents with automatic edge detection, cropping, and color enhancement via native APIs.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter plugin to scan documents as PDF or JPEG using ML Kit on Android and VisionKit on iOS. It automatically detects edges, crops images, and enhances colors.
use_when: You need to allow users to scan physical documents in your Flutter app.
You want automatic edge detection and image enhancement using native platform APIs.
avoid_when: You need custom non-document barcode scanning or general camera preview integration.
You require complex cross-platform custom UI overlays for document capture that native APIs do not support.
strengths: Uses native platform APIs (ML Kit on Android and VisionKit on iOS) for high-quality scans.
Supports both PDF and JPEG output formats.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific setup such as modifying Podfiles and Android build.gradle files.
Scanned files are stored in a temporary folder and need manual persistence if required long-term.
data.setup_notes: Requires modifying iOS Podfile for platform version and camera permissions, updating Info.plist with NSCameraUsageDescription, and setting minimum SDK version 21 in Android build.gradle.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose mobile_scanner if you need barcode and QR code scanning rather than document scanning.

alternatives.name: camera
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose camera if you need full programmatic control over the device camera preview and custom image capturing instead of a pre-built document scanner.
